steps.message:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-32, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 184.7 | 18.51 | 18.51
2 | 735.3 | 0.77 | 19.28
3 | 503.9 | 2.27 | 21.55
4 | 56.6 | 33.69 | 55.24
5 | 43.3 | 5.90 | 61.14
6 | 520.0 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we analyze the resistivities of the six layers in groups of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Resistivities:**
    $\rho_1 = 184.7$
    $\rho_2 = 735.3$
    $\rho_3 = 503.9$
    $\rho_4 = 56.6$
    $\rho_5 = 43.3$
    $\rho_6 = 520.0$

2.  **Analyze each group of three:**
    *   **Layers 1-2-3:** $184.7 < 735.3 > 503.9$. This follows the pattern $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$, which is **K**.
    *   **Layers 2-3-4:** $735.3 > 503.9 > 56.6$. This follows the pattern $\rho_1 > \rho_2 > \rho_3$, which is **Q**.
    *   **Layers 3-4-5:** $503.9 > 56.6 > 43.3$. This follows the pattern $\rho_1 > \rho_2 > \rho_3$, which is **Q**.
    *   **Layers 4-5-6:** $56.6 > 43.3 < 520.0$. This follows the pattern $\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$, which is **H**.

3.  **Combine the letters:**
    The sequence of letters in depth order is KQQH.

{"curve_type": "KQQH"}
